Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.events.loot

Class LootContainerFillEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.events.ZentrixEvent
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.events.ZentrixGameEvent
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.events.loot.LootContainerFillEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.bukkit.event.Cancellable
public final class LootContainerFillEvent extends ZentrixGameEvent implements org.bukkit.event.Cancellable
Called before Zentrix generates lazy loot into a container: when a participant first opens it, when they open it again after a refill, or when it is destroyed before being opened and its loot drops instead.

The container has already been claimed for this refill cycle when this fires, so cancelling leaves it exactly as it is - with whatever it holds now, not cleared even for a replacing refill - and it is not generated again until the next refill. Use LootContainerFilledEvent to adjust what was generated instead.

A container that holds slots of two pools, such as a double chest on the Cornucopia's edge, fires once per pool. Eager Cornucopia population at match start does not fire this event.

Main thread; only fired while a listener is registered.

Since:
1.8.0
